runs.model: YOLOv8 - car parts (2 variants: with / without side mirrors)

runs.notes: Powers photo → part detection on Siteauto (utils/detect.py, inference confidence floor 0.15). The with/without-mirror variants exist because side mirrors altered the vehicle aspect ratio.

runs.training: Fine-tuned plate detector paired with GLM vision OCR for Romanian & EU license formats
runs.notes: Real-time edge recognition in Detectie: YOLO isolates the vehicle license plate, GLM-OCR parses alphanumeric characters, streaming over WebSocket to an ESP32 hardware barrier controller.

runs.model: CataAI v3 (Romanian Transformer from Scratch - 38.1M params)
runs.dataset: Phase 1: 135.1 MB tech/history (69M tokens) + Phase 2: 3.45 MB ChatML
runs.framework: Pure PyTorch · FlashAttention SDPA · RoPE · SwiGLU · BPE (4096)

runs.notes: Built 100% from first principles: 8 layers, 8 heads, d_model=512, 512 context, custom UTF-8 BPE with Romanian diacritics, bfloat16, Fused AdamW, KV-cache, and streaming CLI inference (chat_ro.py).
